sources.excerpt: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. Consolidated statements in millions except per-share: revenues 41,525 (2025 37,895; 2024 34,857); net income 7,457 (6,197; 4,136); diluted EPS 7.80 (6.36; 4.20); income from operations 8,331 (7,205; 5,011). OCF 14,996 (13,092; 10,234); capital expenditures (594) ((658); (736)); SBC 3,509 (3,183; 2,787); common-stock repurchases (12,596); taxes for net share settlement (351); dividends (1,587); acquisitions net of cash (9,268). Balance January 31 2026: cash 7,327; marketable securities 2,238; debt current 4,000; noncurrent debt 10,439; operating lease liabilities current 548 and noncurrent 2,189; goodwill 57,941. Shares outstanding 929 million January 31 and approximately 923 million February 25. Subscription revenue 39,388: Sales 9,028; Service 9,818; Platform Slack Other 8,882; Marketing Commerce 5,428; Integration Analytics 6,232. Platform includes Informatica subscription 388. Regions: Americas 27,193; Europe 10,017; Asia Pacific 4,315. Pricing not a significant driver of FY26 revenue increase. No customer >10% revenue. Term licenses approximately 6% subscription revenue. Offerings renamed Agentforce in Q3 FY26 without reallocation. Fiscal 2026 GAAP operating margin 20.1%.

sources.title: Second quarter fiscal 2027 results, August 26 2026
sources.excerpt: Quarter ended July 31 2026: revenue $11.3bn +11%, Informatica $456m; subscription/support $10.8bn +12%, Informatica $440m. cRPO $33.5bn +14% Y/Y and CC; RPO $66.3bn +11%. Agentforce/Data 360 ARR nearly $3.9bn, over 210% growth; Agentforce ARR exceeded $1.5bn, over 240% growth; effective Q2 FY27 Agentforce ARR includes AI offerings, Slackbot and Headless 360. 7.0bn AWUs delivered to date, 3.2bn Q2 +97% Q/Q. Data 360 104trillion records incl 82trillion Zero Copy. FY27 revenue guidance $46.1-46.4bn +11-12%, slightly above 3pts Informatica; raise $200m reflects $100m organic, $200m acquisitions, $100m FX headwind. GAAP margin 20.1%, adjusted 34.3%; OCF/FCF growth approximately 4-5%. $25bn ASR final settlement expected October 2026, EPS guidance includes 103m initial shares delivered but excludes final settlement. Contentful and Fin then expected to close Q3; all guidance except cRPO incorporates them.
